title: Plumeform contact with topic pills
description: On warm paper: eyebrow, bold heading and lead on the left with pill-shaped topic choices (the chosen one fills with ink) and a short dotted list; on the right a translucent glass form card over drifting mint and sky clouds, with 10px-radius fields, a full-width ink pill button and a small note. Rises in on scroll.
notes: topic pills are radio inputs styled with :has(), so no JavaScript
the form posts to `action`; wire it to your own handler
